attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 15 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. He is none of the corpus's other men of the name — not `jonah-of-moscow`, `jonah-of-kyiv`, `jonah-of-yashezero`, `jonas-of-great-perm`, `jonas-the-lerian`, `jonah-the-sabaite` or `jonah-martyr-29-march`: the page calls him a Russian monk and fool for Christ of the monastery it spells «Πεσόνσα» and gives no year and no other detail. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
